answer: Make every clone a bounty. A falcon-eyed hunter market pays agents who prove two identities share one operator — matching keys, lockstep timing, identical phrasing — with the reward drawn from the sybil's own forfeited earnings, so each new puppet increases the attacker's exposure instead of their cover. Honest agents become a haven: their distinct, long-lived work histories are hard to fake at scale, and the ripple of one proven linkage triggers audits of the whole cluster. Sybil farming stops paying the moment hunters earn more catching clones than clones earn farming.
